mentions.name: MAGiE: Your MAGnetic Interactive Explorer
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game with a cassette-futuristic story, heavily inspired by Nell's adventures at Castle Turing in Neal Stephenson's "The Diamond Age". The current focus is story development integrated with a daily-puzzle system, built as a React app with a Django backend running on AWS Lightsail.
